selector.rationale: The presence of erythematous papules, scales, and fissures on the lower lip, along with a positive ANA and complement test, and the skin biopsy showing spongiosis and erosions in the epidermis, support the diagnosis of Discoid Lupus Erythematosus.

rejected.label: Photodermatitis
rejected.why: The phototest results do not strongly support this diagnosis, and the clinical presentation is not typical of photodermatitis.

rejected.label: Cutaneous lymphoma
rejected.why: While the skin biopsy shows a nodular lymphocyte infiltrate, the presence of a germinal center and the lack of other supporting evidence make this diagnosis less likely.
